chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abu Damrah Anas ibn 'Iyadh al-Laythi from Sa'd ibn 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Umayr said: I heard a man from the Banu al-Harith ibn Ka'b said: I heard Abu Hurayrah saying:
It is not I who forbids the fasting of Friday, but I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) say: 'Do not fast on Friday unless you fast before it or after it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on fasting exclusively on Friday in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the prohibition of *takhassus* (singling out) Friday for voluntary fasting, a ruling supported by the consensus of Shia jurists to distinguish it from the obligatory Jumu'ah prayer. The condition of fasting the preceding or following day ensures the day is not isolated as a unique act of worship, aligning with the Prophetic tradition of integrating Friday into the broader rhythm of weekly devotion.
